examples.title: House at night
examples.description: Paints a house, a moon and a sky of random stars in SV BASIC's high-resolution SCREEN 1, with a caption printed straight onto the graphics; press any key to return to BASIC.

examples.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
examples.description: Asks for a temperature in Celsius, converts it to Fahrenheit and notes when water would freeze or boil.

examples.title: Guess my number
examples.description: The SV-328 picks a number from 1 to 100 and answers each guess with HIGHER or LOWER, then plays a short tune when you find it; Space starts a new round.

manuals.title: BASIC Reference Manual for SVI-318/328
manuals.note: Spectravideo's reference to SV Extended BASIC, every statement and function; Internet Archive scan
